title: alchemilla alpina f. corsica
intro: Alchemilla alpina f. corsica, commonly known as Corsican lady's mantle, is a subspecies of the Alchemilla alpina plant, belonging to the Rosaceae family. This perennial herb is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla alpina f. corsica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
